title: 🎉Raycast 2.0 is out of Beta!
summary: View what's new in Raycast v2.0
body_markdown:
[v2.0](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/macos/2-0) August 25, 2026


Raycast 2.0 is out of Beta! 🎉


Thank you so much for being a part of it! We would not be at this point without all of your feedback and support.


With this release, Raycast v2 replaces v1. You will be guided through the update in Raycast, and your existing v2 beta data will remain unchanged. If you have not imported your v1 data yet, you will have the option to do so during the update. Some permissions may need to be authorized again after the migration.


During the beta, Dictation and AI Chat were available for free while we tested and improved the experience. With this release, these features will now be part of Raycast Pro. To help with the transition, signing in gives you a 7-day free trial of Pro. No credit card is required.


[For more information on the update process, see our FAQ.](https://manual.raycast.com/new-in-v2#faq)


## ✨ New


- **AI** : Added a Clear Chat action, which resets a chat's messages while keeping its model, agent, and other configuration
- **AI** : Added support for mentioning AI extensions when replying to a question asked with the Ask User Question tool
- **AI** : Ask User Question tool can be collapsed to make browsing conversation easier while questions are unanswered
- **MCP** : Added loopback OAuth redirects so MCP providers that reject custom URL schemes, such as Atlassian, can now be connected


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI** : Error messages are clearer, more specific, and show a potential action to recover, like retry, change model, etc.
- **AI** : In the composer.` backspace` now only deletes text, and` cmd+backspace` is used to remove attachments, then the queued message, then the agent, then the folder
- **AI** : Code blocks now render tabs at four-space width
- **AI** : Speed up Screen Awareness screenshot captures
- **AI** : Improved OCR for PDFs when retrieving relevant context for AI conversations
- **AI Commands** : Updated the default AI Commands model to GPT-5.6 Luna
- **Dictation** : Added a word count to the details of each entry in dictation history
- **UI** : Improved scrolling performance across the app
- **Window Management** : Center hotkey now truly centers a window when “Respect Stage Manager” setting is enabled and there is enough space on the desktop for the centered window not to occlude the stage manager strip


## 🐞 Fixes


- **AI** : Fixed chats sometimes staying stuck in a working state after an agent or tool run had already finished, including after reopening the app
- **AI** : Fixed tool errors from third-party extensions being shown as raw JSON
- **AI** : Fixed an attachment error being shown for messages that had no attachment
- **AI** : Fixed a single failed image generation ending the whole run
- **AI** : Fixed long-running requests timing out too early by separating the wait for the first response from the idle timeout during streaming
- **AI** : Fixed a crash on machines where synced models had not been fully restored
- **AI** : Fixed importing settings and data deleting attachments from existing chats
- **AI** : Fixed compaction not reserving context when compacting in-between tool calls
- **AI Chat** : Fixed the pinned section in the sidebar reopening on every launch
- **AI Skills** : Fixed skill folders Raycast cannot read causing repeated background errors, and marked them with a "No Access" badge in Skills settings
- **Calculator** : Fixed calculator results not being saved to history when the main window was hidden or popped to root
- **Notes** : Fixed text being turned into links incorrectly
- **Notes** : Fixed bug in note deeplinks which opened last viewed note instead of linked note
- **Root Search** : Fixed Tab both opening a file and starting Quick AI
